build_hf_headers_with_token: build HF API headers with a string token for authenticated requests
build_hf_headers_with_cached_token: build HF API headers using a cached token when token=True is passed
build_hf_headers_with_custom_user_agent: build HF API headers with a custom user agent string or dict
build_hf_headers_with_library_info: build HF API headers with library_name and library_version for user agent
deduplicate_user_agent_string: deduplicate user agent string entries while preserving order and different values
